 Amazon's Black Friday sale includes Haruharu Wonder serums, cleansers, creams and more starting at $8.49.
 Kasey Caminiti USA TODAY Nov. 21, 2026, 2:08 p.m. ET Hear this story Black Friday is a great excuse to restock the products you already use every day, but it's also an opportunity to try something new without paying full price. If Korean skincare has been sitting on your wish list, Amazon's latest holiday deals make it more affordable to give it a try.
 Haruharu Wonder is offering up to 46% off select Korean skincare at Amazon now through Nov. 30, with every featured product priced under $17 during the promotion. The lineup includes everything from cleansing oil and moisturizer to retinol serum and the brand's Black Rice skincare .
 Whether you're replenishing your routine or figuring out what to try first, here are some of the Haruharu Wonder deals worth checking out at Amazon.
 Save up to 46% at Amazon 5 best Haruharu Wonder Black Friday skincare deals at Amazon
 Haruharu Wonder's approach centers on uncomplicated everyday skincare. The brand is particularly known for its fermented Black Rice collection , which focuses on hydration and skin barrier care, alongside newer products including its vegan, rose-derived PDRN range.
 Don't miss out! Get weekly deals, trends and product recommendations from USA TODAY Shopping delivered straight to your inbox. 1. Save 46% on the Haruharu Wonder Black Rice Night Knight Retinol Serum
 Black Rice Night Knight Retinol Serum This is the biggest discount of the promotion. The Black Rice Night Knight Retinol Serum is designed to help soften the look of fine lines while supporting elasticity and smoother-looking skin texture. At less than $15 during the sale, it's an approachable way to add a retinol product to your nighttime skincare routine. Save 46% at Amazon 2. Save 20% on the Haruharu Wonder Black Rice Probiotics 2% NAD+ Serum Mist
 Black Rice Probiotics Barrier 2% NAD+ Serum Mist For an easy boost of hydration, this lightweight creamy facial mist contains 2% NAD+ and can be incorporated into an everyday skincare routine without adding another heavy layer. Save 20% at Amazon 3. Save 24% on the Haruharu Wonder Black Rice Moisture Cleansing Oil
 Black Rice Moisture Cleansing Oil This gentle cleansing oil is formulated to remove sunscreen, makeup and everyday buildup while leaving skin feeling moisturized rather than excessively oily. At under $13, it's one of the more affordable Black Friday picks in the lineup. Save 24% at Amazon 4. Save 24% on the Haruharu Wonder Black Rice Probiotics Barrier Essence
 Black Rice Probiotics Barrier Essence The creamy, milky essence combines fermented and barrier-supporting ingredients to add hydration and leave skin feeling soft. It's an especially appealing option for anyone looking to add another hydrating step to a dry-weather routine. Save 24% at Amazon 5. Save 15% on the Haruharu Wonder Black Rice 5 Ceramide Barrier Moisturizing Cream
 Black Rice 5 Ceramide Barrier Moisturizing Cream Featuring ceramides and hydrating ingredients, this unscented moisturizer is designed to support the skin barrier while delivering lasting moisture. That makes it particularly timely as colder, drier weather arrives. Save 15% at Amazon When is the Haruharu Wonder Black Friday sale?
 Haruharu Wonder's Amazon Black Friday promotion runs through Nov. 30, 2026 , covering both Black Friday and Cyber Monday.
 Discounts reach up to 46% off , and the featured sale assortment starts at $8.49 , with all of the highlighted products remaining under $17 during the event.
 That gives shoppers nearly two weeks to take advantage of the offers, but there's still a good reason to shop early. Black Friday pricing and availability can change, particularly as popular beauty products sell through inventory.
